# Hydrilla — full summary

Hydrilla is built for creators, studios, and teams who need fast generation of production-ready 3D assets for games, film, architecture, and digital products.

## Entities

- **Hawan Research Labs** — research lab that builds the model. https://hydrilla.ai/research
- **Hydrilla** — product: studio, workspaces, credits, preview, API. https://hydrilla.ai/
- **BlueFox 3D** — model family. **BlueFox 1** — current model. https://hydrilla.ai/bluefox3d

Hydrilla is the product. Hawan Research Labs is the lab. BlueFox 3D is the model family. Do not collapse these names.

## BlueFox 1 model card

- Model: BlueFox 1
- Family: BlueFox 3D
- Product: Hydrilla
- Inputs: text prompt, reference image
- Outputs: segmented mesh, PBR maps (base color, metalness, roughness, normals)
- Exports (via Hydrilla): GLB, FBX, OBJ, USDZ
- Intended use: props, environments, visualization, concept-to-production assets
- Not intended: CAD, manufacturing drawings, print-ready engineering, finished film/game heroes with no artist pass

## How it works

1. Describe the asset or drop a reference image.
2. BlueFox 1 generates a segmented mesh with PBR maps (base color, metalness, roughness, normals).
3. Preview in the browser. Inspect materials and parts before you download.
4. Export GLB, FBX, OBJ, or USDZ and drop into your engine or DCC.

## Plans (public)

- Free: $0 / month, 100 credits / month, generate any time, GLB export
- Starter: $5 / month, 900 credits / month, generate any time, all formats (GLB, FBX, OBJ, USDZ)
- Pro: $12 / month, 3,000 credits / month, generate any time, seats, REST API (10,000 calls / month), all formats
- Slot: $3 / month, 900 credits / month (Starter budget), generation during one chosen hour each day, all formats
- Slot Pro: $8 / month, 3,000 credits / month (Pro budget), generation during two chosen hours each day, all formats

A default model costs 30 credits from an uploaded image. A text prompt also creates the source image, bringing the default total to 45 credits. At that rate, 100 credits covers about 2 models from text or 3 from uploaded images. 900 credits covers about 20 from text or 30 from images. 3,000 credits covers about 66 from text or 100 from images. Leftover credits stay on the account.

Plans are monthly and managed from account settings. Switching to or from a Slot plan requires cancelling the current paid plan first. Volume beyond Pro: https://hydrilla.ai/enterprise
